Container.Name: metra-tracker-plus
Container.Overview: Self-hosted live Metra train tracker: map of all lines with live train positions, a departure board for your station, service alerts, long-term delay history, and a Home Assistant-friendly commute API. Uses Metra's GTFS schedule and GTFS-Realtime feeds (server-side only). Runs schedule-only until METRA_API_TOKEN is set.
Container.Requires: Uses the image published by the project on GitHub (ghcr.io/heyimdownhere/metra-tracker-plus). To run a locally built image instead, set Repository to metra-tracker-plus:latest. See README.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port you open in the browser (http://TOWER-IP:THIS-PORT). Change this one if 8080 is taken on the server.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Cached Metra schedule and history database.

Config.Name: Metra API key
Config.Description: Your Metra GTFS-Realtime API key. Leave empty for schedule-only mode.

Config.Name: Home station
Config.Description: Optional default home station: an id like EVANSTON or a name like Evanston (Davis St.). Used until 'Set as home' is tapped in the app. Ids are listed at /api/stations.

Config.Name: Work station
Config.Description: Optional work station (id or name, e.g. OTC). On workdays the app opens on home to work before the switch time and work to home after it. Can also be set in the app (briefcase button).

Config.Name: Commute switch time
Config.Description: 24-hour time when the app switches from trains to work to trains home, e.g. 12:00 or 13:30.

Config.Name: Workdays
Config.Description: Days you commute, e.g. mon-fri or mon,tue,thu.

Config.Name: Home destination
Config.Description: Optional default 'Going to' station for the home board, e.g. OTC (Ogilvie) or CUS (Union Station).

Config.Name: HISTORY_DAYS
Config.Description: Days of realtime delay/alert history to keep in /config/history.db. 0 disables history.

Config.Name: REALTIME_INTERVAL
Config.Description: Seconds between realtime polls. Minimum 30 (Metra's limit).

Config.Name: STATIC_CHECK_INTERVAL
Config.Description: Seconds between checks for a new Metra schedule (minimum 60).

Config.Name: STATIC_FULL_REFRESH_DAYS
Config.Description: Re-download the whole Metra schedule this often (days) even if Metra says it is unchanged; the previous copy is kept as a backup. 0 turns it off.

Config.Name: Download map to the server
Config.Description: Download a Chicago-area OpenStreetMap map (Protomaps) once into appdata and serve it from the server, so phones never load map tiles from outside. Set false to skip (the map then uses online maps or the Simple background).

Config.Name: MAP_MAX_ZOOM
Config.Description: Most detailed map level to download (8-15). 14 roughly quarters the download size; the app still zooms in further, slightly less sharp.

Config.Name: MAP_REFRESH_DAYS
Config.Description: Re-download the map after this many days (0 = never).

Config.Name: LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING or ERROR. The container log starts with a summary of all settings (API key masked).
